lines.text: This is Ingot, running live on Mohnad testnet. Everything you're about to see is a real transaction, from a brand-new wallet.
lines.caption: This is Ingot, running live on Monad testnet. Everything you're about to see is a real transaction, from a brand-new wallet.

lines.text: Ingot turns the price of renting a G P U into a market you can trade, hedge, and borrow against.
lines.caption: Ingot turns the price of renting a GPU into a market you can trade, hedge, and borrow against.

lines.text: Open the terminal, and connect a wallet.
lines.caption: Open the terminal, and connect a wallet.

lines.text: This is the index: the on-demand price of one H one hundred G P U hour, published on chain. Every print carries its methodology, and the quotes and venues behind it.
lines.caption: This is the index: the on-demand price of one H100 GPU-hour, published on-chain. Every print carries its methodology, and the quotes and venues behind it.

lines.text: The wallet is empty, so the faucet sends it test U S D C. One transaction, confirmed in a block.
lines.caption: The wallet is empty, so the faucet sends it test USDC. One transaction, confirmed in a block.

lines.text: Post twenty thousand as margin. Approve, then deposit.
lines.caption: Post $20,000 as margin. Approve, then deposit.

lines.text: Now, go long ten lots: seventy-three hundred G P U hours. Before you sign, the ticket shows your fill, the margin it locks, the fee, and the worst price the contract will accept.
lines.caption: Now, go long 10 lots: 7,300 GPU-hours. Before you sign, the ticket shows your fill, the margin it locks, the fee, and the worst price the contract will accept.

lines.text: Filled, in one block. The position is live, and marked to the index.
lines.caption: Filled, in one block. The position is live, and marked to the index.

lines.text: Here's that same trade, on the explorer.
lines.caption: Here's that same trade, on the explorer.

lines.text: Now, the reason this market exists. On the credit desk, a G P U operator borrows against next month's revenue: a hundred thousand G P U hours, at the index rate, with the minimum margin.
lines.caption: Now, the reason this market exists. On the credit desk, a GPU operator borrows against next month's revenue: 100,000 GPU-hours, at the index rate, with the minimum margin.

lines.text: One click draws the loan, and opens its hedge, in the same transaction. All of it happens, or none of it does.
lines.caption: One click draws the loan, and opens its hedge, in the same transaction. All of it happens, or none of it does.

lines.text: Now drag the settlement rate. Unhedged, the lender's recovery falls through the debt. Hedged, it holds at every rate. Every point is read straight from the contract.
lines.caption: Now drag the settlement rate. Unhedged, the lender's recovery falls through the debt. Hedged, it holds at every rate. Every point is read straight from the contract.

lines.text: On the other side of every trade is the underwriter vault. It quotes both ways off the mark, and earns the spread and the fees.
lines.caption: On the other side of every trade is the underwriter vault. It quotes both ways off the mark, and earns the spread and the fees.

lines.text: Deposit ten thousand, and the vault mints shares at the current share price.
lines.caption: Deposit $10,000, and the vault mints shares at the current share price.

lines.text: Back on the terminal, closing is one click, and the profit or loss lands straight in margin.
lines.caption: Back on the terminal, closing is one click, and the profit or loss lands straight in margin.

lines.text: Ingot. Compute, priced and hedged. Live now, on Mohnad testnet.
lines.caption: Ingot. Compute, priced and hedged. Live now, on Monad testnet.
